label: How a heat pump works

label: Summarise the idea
prompt: Summarise in one sentence: Small servers in the basement of a house do computing jobs for paying customers. Their waste heat goes into the house's heating and hot water. A scheduler runs the jobs when the house needs heat and pauses them when it does not.

label: Reasons to pause a job
